How to Use SafarVibe — A Complete Guide

From your first sign-in to reading price history charts — everything you need to get the most out of SafarVibe.

1. Sign in with Google

Open safarvibe.co.in and tap Login with Google. It's completely free and there's no card to add. Your routes stay private to your account.

2. Add your first route

Tap + Add Route and pick three things:

  • Origin — where you're flying from (start typing a city, then choose from the suggestions).
  • Destination — where you're flying to.
  • Date — your travel date.

That's it. SafarVibe starts monitoring that route automatically.

3. Watch your tracked routes

Your home screen lists every route you're tracking, along with the number of flights found and when prices were last refreshed. Tap a route to open its live results and price history.

4. Read the price history chart

SafarVibe keeps an eye on the route for you. It records how the price moves over time and adds it to a chart, so you can see:

  • Whether today's fare is higher or lower than the recent average.
  • When the price dropped or spiked.
  • Whether this is a good moment to book or worth waiting.

5. Pause and resume routes

Planning a trip months away? You can pause a route anytime to stop updates, and resume it when you're ready. Paused routes stay saved so you don't lose them.

6. Use it on your phone

SafarVibe is a progressive web app. On Android or iPhone you can install it as an app on your home screen — it opens full-screen like a native app and stays one tap away.

Tips for getting the most out of SafarVibe

  • Track a route for at least a week before booking to understand its normal price range.
  • Track early for fixed-date travel (festivals, holidays) so you can act on price drops.
  • Check the chart before booking — if the fare is near the low end of the trend, that's usually a good time.
  • Keep several routes active at once and compare which date is cheapest.
